topology.description: Reduced forward-wave circuit: posterior touch initiates A27h-like premotor activity; each premotor excites a segment motor pool and a local PMSI-like inhibitory termination pool; shortening-sensitive proprioception excites the next anterior premotor pool.
limitations: Not a complete brain or VNC connectome.
The reduced proprioceptor-to-next-premotor edge is a circuit-level approximation, not a claimed identified monosynaptic connection.
One bilateral longitudinal motor pool represents many neurons and muscles per segment.
Each PMSI-like pool is a reduced inhibitory termination motif, not a claim that one identified neuron or monosynaptic edge implements the entire segmental off-switch.

parameter_provenance.objective: Produce a stable posterior-to-anterior neural and contraction wave whose adjacent motor-onset phase delays fall inside the Greaney 2026 L1 animal-level p10-p90 bands; use a PMSI-like inhibitory motif to constrain motor bursts; and fit continuous motor-excitation and muscle-activation dynamics to the published segment contraction amplitude, shortening-rate, and duration bands.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: The 2.5 s cycle period, reduced relay delays, PMSI recruitment/current, thresholded two-stage activation dynamics, segment-specific activation and relaxation time constants, and shortening capacities are MODEL_FITTED. The capacities use Greaney L1 segment-amplitude medians as in-sample targets, not direct muscle maximum-shortening measurements. Passing the checked-in bands is calibration, not held-out validation, and none of these values is a measured single-neuron, muscle, or single-synapse constant.

muscle_identity_projection.method: equal identity recruitment aggregated by arithmetic mean to the calibrated axial segment actuator
limitations: No individual attachment coordinates, lines of action, CSA, or force gains are implied.
T3 and A7 remain reduced aggregate actuators because the atlas blocks homology outside A1-A6.
Equal recruitment is an explicit proxy pending L1 muscle recruitment measurements.
